cards.heading: User awareness
cards.body: Ongoing reminders that keep security in mind: posters, emails and simulated phishing campaigns that show staff what a real attack looks like and who to report it to.

cards.heading: User training
cards.body: Formal, scheduled training, often required by policy or regulation, on the organisation's rules: acceptable use, data handling, passwords and how to report incidents.

cards.heading: Physical access control
cards.body: Keeping unauthorised people away from equipment: locked rooms and racks, badge readers, cameras, guards and an access control vestibule (mantrap) where only one door opens at a time. Physical access to a device defeats most other controls, because the console port allows password recovery.
